historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission named the tulip garden east of the old North Dutch Windmill The Queen Wilhelmina Garden, as a tribute to the late Queen of the Netherlands and in thanks to the people of Holland, whose gifts of tulip bulbs had made the garden possible.
